reference.title: Scenario 4 — Consecutive headings with no body content
reference.shortdesc: Consider an HTML document where multiple consecutive headings at any level have no body content

section.p: Consider an HTML document where multiple consecutive headings at any level have no body content between them.

section.p: Result:Each heading with no body content directly beneath it is converted to a <topichead> navigation container rather than a .dita topic file. The first heading that has body content beneath it — <h3> (System Requirements) — generates a .ditamap and a corresponding .dita topic file, and is referenced in the parent map using a <mapref> element.
section.note: Add at least a short introductory paragraph directly beneath any heading that should become a real .dita topic rather than a navigation-only <topichead>. Without body content, the converter has no material from which to generate a topic file.
